notes:
### New

- Bare hands. With nothing in your hand, attacking throws a punch. It's weak and short and it tires you, but it makes no sound, and it tears through webs too.
- Drop boxes. Materials, treasure and anything else without a shape of its own go into an iron box at your feet when you drop them underground. Anything else you drop nearby goes into the same box. Anyone can open any box, and the prompt says whose it is. A box closed empty is gone.
- Sort the Stash and the Store. The round button below the filters sorts them as placed, by value, by name or by type. Each one keeps the order you left it in.
- Rumors has a ledge in the training vault where you learn to hammer in a piton and hang a rope.
- Item durability now reads as what is left of the most it can take, like 75/100, under each slot, in the tooltip and in Inspect.

### Changes

- The game is always over the shoulder now, crouched and crawling too. First person and its camera toggle are gone. You see through your own eyes only in the water, on the map and while spectating.
- Your explorer's head turns to where you look before the body follows, and your own body is lit by your lamp.
- Crawling moves smoothly, with no jump in the loop.
- Spider webs look like webs. Each blow tears more of a web and shakes it, and looking at one tells you how to get through: swing a weapon at it, or throw something that burns.
- Snares and tripwire bells show where you set them, and you can take them back up with E (X on a controller). A bell keeps its wear.
- Held things are the right size and point the right way, and the rifle, derringer, pitons, lockpicks, glow sticks, laudanum, grave dirt, blessed salt and censer have new models.
- New sounds for the crossbow, rifle, hatchet, spade, spear, slingshot, oil bottle, firecrackers, tripwire bell, whistle, pitons, laudanum and the Workshop.
- The Library and the Workshop fill the window, and their lists scroll.

### Fixes

- You can climb out of the pools in the Pump Room and the Drowned Chapel, and you can no longer swim under their walkways and out of the world.
